svg.text: reconcile token vs git ground truth → ledger
Safety net (L3)
• park protocol — nothing loose is binned
• run-ledger + runcheck — no silent deferral
• Stop-hook — harness-enforced backstop
Ends: queue-drained · all-parked · budget-hit
What L3 gives you
The agent drives the whole delivery loop unattended and parks anything it can't call. You're on the loop:
the correctness net is the mechanical park-protocol + ledger, not you staying awake. Review is a single senior pass
(swappable to adversarial). Termination is by queue emptiness or a user budget — there is no code-blind judge,
no live watcher, and no host-isolation requirement. Blast radius = your machine.
L4 · OUT of the loop
lights-out — you're down the pub; correctness held by adversarial machinery
🔒 CONTAINER (ADR-0010) — host-isolation blast-radius cage · faff never self-grants --dangerously-skip-permissions
lights-out preflight (FAIL-CLOSED — any miss ⇒ refuse, mint nothing)
container contained · spend/time budget ceiling SET (count-cap alone refused) · adversarial review + spec_review reachable ·
dial-coherence (no reckless dial tuple) · all 8 guardrail contracts live · FAFF-68 no-execute + floor assertions

🛰 SENTRY — live derailment watcher
reads the append-only surface, never mutates:
events.jsonl · run-ledger · heartbeat · budget

rate · escaped side-effect · wall-clock

IMPLEMENTOR LANE — full codebase R/W · spec (isolated subagents; returns only a token)
EVALUATOR LANE — running environment + spec only · marks the work from the outside
NO CODEBASE
holdout fires
the evaluator marks the delivered behaviour against a spec it never saw the code for — a passing signal ≠ “tests passed”, it means the feature works
Safety net (L4) — no human in the net:
container (blast radius bounded) · adversarial 2nd-model review · isolated CODE-BLIND holdout · Sentry resumable kill-switch · run-done doneness
L4 = L3's whole loop, moved inside the cage, with a second opinion that can't collude, a judge that can't see the code, and a watcher that can't be reached by what it watches.
